title: An AI companion is being developed for style reflection
summary: Yourcore’s founder describes AI-assisted app development and an intended style companion; benefits to users’ wellbeing or consumption remain unmeasured.
source_collection: University of Texas AI Opportunity Inventory
account: Yourcore is being developed as an outfit journal with an AI companion. Founder Christina Karaba publicly described building its website and developing the app with AI assistance in December 2025. The public site offers a beta signup and names Cori. A later presentation account describes an outfit-of-the-day journal with an AI companion. These sources establish a developing product and its intended purpose. They do not establish improvements in users’ mental health, clothing purchases, cognition, or other downstream outcomes.
purpose: The proposed companion is intended to help users reflect on their own style rather than follow generic recommendations.
system: Yourcore/Cori; runtime model not established by the reviewed external sources
